3.3
Report in RDL schema 2005/01
The following is an example of the RDL for a report in Schema version RDL 2005/01. It shows the
usage of the various properties of a Report. This example shows elements for describing the data:
DataSources and DataSets; elements for describing the structure and layout: Report.PageHeader,
Report.PageFooter, and Body; and elements for describing the ReportParameters for the report.
The following figure shows an example rendering of this report.
Figure 11: RDL schema 2005/01 report rendering

 5      <ConnectionProperties>
 6        <DataProvider>SQL</DataProvider>
 7        <ConnectString>data source=DataServer; initial catalog=Northwind;</ConnectString>
 8      </ConnectionProperties>
 9    </DataSource>
 10  </DataSources>
